content: Moisés ome-Cus-yargined-nikusad-ular, e-bun-María, degi, e-ia-Aarón, egi isdar sunmakarmalad.
María, Aarón-ebogwa sokarmalad: “¿Unnila Bab-Jehová Moisésʼgarbi sunmaksasi? ¿Anmarga Bab-Jehová sunmaksasurmosi? Anmarga sunmaksamoga.” María, Aarónʼbo-deyob-sogmaladi, Bab-Jehová itosad.
Ar Moisésʼdi, dule-na-san-dummarba-imaksulidid. We-napneggi-dulemar-baiganba bur na san-maikwaa imakdiid.
Geb degine, Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga, Aarónʼga, degi, Maríaʼga sogded: “Bemar-warbaagwad dulemar-anbo-ambikued-negse namar.” Degine, wemar-warbaagwad Bab-Dummad-dulemarbo-ambikued-negse nadmarsunnad.
Agine, Bab-Jehová mogir-bubawaryob-gwichidba, ese-goled-neg-seleged-yawagakse aidenonikid. Geb Aarónʼse, degi, Maríaʼse gochad. Amar-ebogwad nonimargua,

content.text: Ar Moisésʼdi anga-arbamalad-baiganba bur inniki gudiid-duled.

content: Geb degine, Bab-Jehová Maríaʼgi, degi, Aarónʼgi sae-itogedba uluded. Geb a-sorbali, Bab-Jehová nadsunnad.
Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi mogir-naid-bangudeyalaba, María naibe-buna-yaa-maleged nikuded, bela e-uka sibudik-dakle naded. Aarón Maríaʼsik atakdegu, dakded María naibe-buna-yaa-maleged nika.
Aarón, Moisésʼga sogded: “Dummad, anmar yogasaar-binsaedsuli-begi-sunmaksadba anmar begi isgusad. A-ulale, melle be sabsur-anmar-odurdake.
Geb degine, Moisés wilesagwa Bab-Jehováʼse gochad: “Bab-Dummadye, wilesakwaa an bese egised, María be emisbinne be nudake.”

Bab-Jehová Moisés-abin sogded: “E-bab, María wagargi-wiaksana, ¿María ibagugle (7) bingegudiguosulin be insae? Bingegudii guoenad. Degisoggu, ibagugle-wilub (7) María dulemar-danar-danar-bukwad-abargi be onogo. A-ibagan-sorbali, sunna gannar dulemar-danar-danar-bukwadse nonibaloed.”
Weyobi, María dulemar-danar-danar-bukwad-abargi ibagugle-wilub (7) onolesad. A-ibagangine, María-gannar-nonikidse Israel-dulemar e-danar-danar-bukwamaladgi gwen baid-yarse bangussurmalad.
Geb a-sorbali, Israel-dulemar Hazerotʼgi-bukwamaladgi nadmalad, nega-dulesulidgan-Paránʼye-nugadse modapmalad. Agi, Israel-dulemar danar-danar ambikudapmarsunnad.
